# CWI Public Registry (llms.txt)

> Machine front door to every Cumulative Web Inc product and agent tool.
> 38 cards, schema https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/registry/agent-card-schema.json, registry JSON https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/registry/registry.json
> Per-product pages: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/registry/<slug>/ (index.html, agent-card.json, llms.txt). Updated 2026-10-01.

## Truth labels

- verified-live: try URL returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-01; card schema-valid.
- repo-ci / repo-no-ci: public GitHub repo exists (with/without CI); try URL not 200.
- staged-unshipped: the conversion leg is not live (a pre-launch page may exist) — awaits founder taps.
- no-public-repo: workspace or goal-directory only; no public repo found.
- unknown: not verified; treat claims as unverified.

## Validator

node validate-cards.js — zero-dependency; CI-enforced on every push (.github/workflows/validate-registry.yml).
